endpoints.name: enroll
endpoints.summary: Trade the one-time token and a CSR for a node certificate. A spent token answers `enrollment_token_invalid`.

endpoints.name: hello
endpoints.summary: Open a session and negotiate protocol and capabilities. Each hello needs a fresh nonce.

endpoints.name: renew
endpoints.summary: Get a certificate for a freshly generated node key.

endpoints.name: poll
endpoints.summary: Long-poll for a newer whole-node desired state and pending commands.

endpoints.name: report
endpoints.summary: Report observed per-resource state, health, and versions.

endpoints.name: stats
endpoints.summary: Send cumulative per-user traffic counters; the ack names the highest counted `seq`.

endpoints.name: command_result
endpoints.summary: Report a command's outcome; the service stops redelivering it once acknowledged.

endpoints.name: blob
endpoints.summary: Download content by SHA-256 (file content and artifacts with source `service`). The agent verifies the hash; an unknown hash answers `not_found`.

long_poll.empty_result: 200 with `desired` null and no commands: nothing changed within `wait_seconds`. The agent polls again after `poll_after_seconds` (0 = at once).
returns_early_when: the node's (fleet_epoch, revision) is newer than the poll's `have`
a command for the node is waiting
the session is about to expire

transport_notes: HTTPS on the control server's port 443 under its secret path; the TLS handshake never requests a client certificate, so it is indistinguishable from today's.
Agents dial out and nodes open no ports. A later WebSocket transport carries the same message bodies.
The agent verifies the service's TLS certificate (WebPKI, or `tls_pin_sha256` from bootstrap) and, independently, the service signature on every desired state and command.
On a network error or a retryable error the agent backs off exponentially with jitter (1 s doubling to 60 s), never below `retry_after_seconds`.
A `session` request answered `unauthenticated` or `credential_expired` sends the agent back to `hello`; `credential_revoked` stops it until SSH bootstrap enrolls it again.
